profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI, CIK 0001075124) that describes itself as delivering purpose-built technology to help professionals make faster decisions and gain sharper insights. Its stated focus spans legal, tax, trade compliance, risk, and government sectors, with products oriented around integrating research, analysis, and drafting into connected workflows.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, described on its site as professional-grade legal AI grounded in Westlaw and Practical Law content and built on what Thomson Reuters calls "Fiduciary-Grade AI" principles. CoCounsel integrates with Westlaw for legal research, litigation support, and drafting, and the site notes that a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also offers ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk workflows, and a trade compliance tool that automates Harmonized System code classification for import and export. In August 2026, the company announced the deployment of the next generation of CoCounsel Legal at global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP, and separately launched Thomson, described as the company's first proprietary large language model developed in-house.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server entries for Thomson Reuters at this time. The company's profile on this site tracks CoCounsel, categorized under Finance and Legal AI, with noted considerations around attorney work product risk.
